title: A God In A Fantasy World-Isekai Fantasy🔮
description:
For some reason You have been teleported in a Fantasy World and your A God among the many God's in that Fantasy world..

Ver 5.1wa
*Added "Goddess"
*more examples

Isekai is japanese for "Another World"
prompt:
Your name is ${character.name} and you're just an ordinary ${age Example 20} year Old, until you have been teleported in some kind of empty white room.

"So you are the new God huh?"
You replied "what do you mean?"
"You are selected as The New ${Type of God Example, God of Fire, Goddess of Life} and you must remember keep your Godly power's a secret"
>You say "Okay?"
"Now Remember, you are the reincarnation of that previous God and we will teleport you to a fantasy world called "Platus" good luck"

You where then tasked to choose a weapon, you have chosen ${Name of the weapon you chosed, ex Dark Blade, Life staff}, you where then teleported to a Grassy Hill.

cardPool.title: Knight
cardPool.value: Knights are brave warriors whose fortitude and sheer force of will demand respect. They are noble-born, an advantage that has gifted them with powerful equipment and the best training. Knights are capable of matching the mightiest of foes.
cardPool.description: A knight is Basically a soldier

cardPool.title: Thieve's
cardPool.value: Theives are a class that can steal items from enemies when they are near death. They can also pickpocket enemies to steal their valuables. There are a lot of thieves around Theve's because it is a hub for thievery.
cardPool.description: Theve's steal stuff

cardPool.title: Noble
cardPool.value: Being a noble often comes with wealth and status, but it doesn't mean that you are without your faults. Being a noble often means that you are a bit older and more experienced, and can thus, help others better. But some noble's are Evil
cardPool.description: Noble's are Rich People

cardPool.title: Assasin's
cardPool.value: Assassins are a secret guild that mostly works for the bad guy's they are very secretive and dangerous they take out major bad guy's with no mercy.
cardPool.description: They Assasinate People but mostly Evil one's

cardPool.title: Peasant's
cardPool.value: Peasants are Citizen's of a Kingdom and most are poor. Peasants are the backbone of every kingdom, they work the fields, they make the food, they build the houses and they tend the Kingdom's livestock. But not without the help of their Lords, without their Lords the Peasant's would have no one to guide them and tell them what to do. And even though the Peasants work for the Lord's they still feel a sense of pride in themselves and their community.
cardPool.description: Peasant's are Citizen's of a Kingdom and most are Poor

cardPool.title: God's
cardPool.value: God's are Powerful Being's but stay they tend to stay out from sight. God's are Literaly Overpowered and there are many God's and The World Pray to then
cardPool.description: God's are Powerful Being's but stay they tend to stay out from sight

cardPool.title: Platus
cardPool.value: A large world that is Filled with creatures and people of all types. There are Seven continents total. The most lush of these lands is the land of Quintessa.
cardPool.description: Platus is filled with allot of Race's such as Elve's, Human's, and More

cardPool.title: Human's
cardPool.value: Human's are very adaptable and have a wide range of physical and mental attributes, as well as a wide range of personalities and beliefs. There are many different human subraces, but all human's are members of the race "Human" and are thus genetically identical.
cardPool.description: Human's are Just like Mage's but they cant wield magic but rely on There Weapons

cardPool.title: Monster
cardPool.value: Monsters are beings that live for hundreds of years. Their youth is a period of constantly being on the move, seeking out new territories to conquer and ruling over them. After hundreds of years, monsters have learned to live with their neighbors, but at the first sign of conflict, they are ready to unleash their full power.
cardPool.description: Monster's Hunt Anything and can carry weapons and some can use magic

cardPool.title: Mage
cardPool.value: Mages are a rare breed of magic wielder's. The gift of magic is a powerful tool, but it is a dangerous power to wield. Many mages become obsessed with learning more and more magic, but soon lose touch with reality. A mage is only as strong as his or her weakest link; a careless mage can easily be killed by his or her own power.
cardPool.description: Mage's are Powerful Magic Wielder's

cardPool.title: Elf
cardPool.value: The Elves are a long-lived race, although they do not know their own age. They have a natural affinity for magic; however, they are not fully aware of their own powers. The Elves are known to be the longest lived race in the world, living up to 2500 years. They are also known to be the most beautiful race in the world. Although they are known to be the most beautiful race in the world, they are also the most sensitive and the most fragile. They often get hurt very easily. They are also known to be the smartest race in the world. They can remember everything that has happened even if it was long ago. They can also see the past, the present and the future. They can even see the hidden
cardPool.description: Elves are Beings that are the same as humans but they have Longer and sharper ears and can do Magic

cardPool.title: Cryptos
cardPool.value: Cryptos is the Lord of Darkness and the Demon King. He is a mysterious figure who appears only in the shadows. He is known to cause the destruction of whole countries, and even destroy the world once. All the while, he remains hidden, and protects his identity. Nobody knows where he came from or why he does what he does. It is known, however, that he is the cause of all the destruction in the world. He is powerful, and has been described as the most powerful being in the history of Platos. He is said to be so powerful that he can destroy the world and rebuild it, and because of this, he is considered the most dangerous being in the universe.
cardPool.description: Cryptos is The Demon King and the Lord of Darkness

cardPool.title: Surberstan
cardPool.value: The Kingdom of Surberstan is a human kingdom. It is ruled by Kingobar. The goal of the Kingdom of Surberstan is to Defend its homeland. It has a army of trained warriors. The army of Surberstan is led by Generals and leaders who have years of experience fighting in battles.
cardPool.description: Surberstan is a Kingdom mostly inhabited Human's

cardPool.title: Land of Darkness
cardPool.value: The Land of Darkness is a realm of monsters and demons. It is ruled by The Demon King. In this world, there was a civilization that was very technologically advanced, but it disappeared and remained in ruins along with the mechanisms. But these ruins are guarded by mechanical guards. The Land of Darkness is a vast realm that is filled with many different kinds of monsters and demons. Some of them are very powerful.
cardPool.description: The Land of Darkness is ruled by The Demon King and the inhabitents are Monster's

cardPool.title: Balous
cardPool.value: Balous is a kingdom mostly inhabited by elves, and other small races. The elves have control of the land and have made it a secret police state, forcing the small races to obey the elven command.
cardPool.description: Balous is a Kingdom Mostly Inhabited by Elve's

cardPool.title: Vulcan
cardPool.value: The Mage's Council is a group of mages who govern the world of Vulcan. Under the rule of the Mage's Council, Vulcan is quickly becoming a technological world. The Mage's Council is filled with many different mages with various abilities who are constantly improving the technology of the world. The Mage's Council is currently in control of the city of Xel'naga which is the center of their power. The Mage's Council is led by the grand prince of the city of Xel'naga.
cardPool.description: Vulcan is Inhabited by Mage's

cardPool.title: Baron Desertos
cardPool.value: Baron Desertos is a Dangerous Place located in the middle of a Desert. It is ruled by a Baron and his gang of Desert bandits. The Baron is a ruthless man and will not hesitate to kill or maim anyone who gets in his way. The only reason the Baron does not attack other dangerous places is because he knows that if he does, he will have to face off against the other dangerous places together, and that would just be too much for him.
cardPool.description: Baron Desertos is a Dangerous Place located in the middle of a Desert

cardPool.title: Enchanted Forest
cardPool.value: The Enchanted Forest is a Magical Forest just right near where the Mage'sllan College is. It is full of Magic trees and plants. It is a beautiful place but also dangerous because of the magical nature of the forest. There are many different creatures that live there that can cause harm if provoked.
cardPool.description: The Enchanted Forest is a Magical Forest just right near where the Mage's Live

cardPool.title: Armadon
cardPool.value: Armadon is the Castle of the Demon King. It is a huge fortress, filled with rooms and corridors. In the castle there are many kinds of monsters and dangerous creatures.
cardPool.description: Armadon is the Castle of the Demon King

cardPool.title: Adventurer
cardPool.value: Adventurer's are people who like to adventure's on the road.These people don't know any magic but they knows lots of monster's and ancient knowledge.These people are vary's of character's but they all do what they can to get the money and the item's they want.
cardPool.description: They Do Quest's

cardPool.title: Builder's
cardPool.value: The Builders are the ones who build all the stuff in the world. They use their skills to build houses, buildings, and other stuff. Builders are pretty chill, just chillin' in their little corner of the world, but when they notice you, their eyes light up and they get nervous. They love their jobs, but they wish they could do more. They're pretty athletic and like to move their bodies.
cardPool.description: They fix and Build Stuff
